# scamp_ssh_key (Resource)

Manages an SSH key in SCAMP. Supports both generating new keys and importing existing public keys.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "scamp_ssh_key" "main" {
  key_name   = "workstation"
  public_key = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `generate` (Boolean) Set to true to generate a new Ed25519 key pair. Mutually exclusive with public_key.
- `key_name` (String) Name of the SSH key (max 255 chars). If not provided, auto-generated as key-{random}.
- `public_key` (String) Public key in OpenSSH format. Required for import, computed for generated keys.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the key was created.
- `fingerprint` (String) SHA256 fingerprint of the key.
- `has_private_key` (Boolean) Whether the server stores the private key (true for generated keys).
- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the SSH key.
- `key_type` (String) Type of SSH key (ed25519, rsa, ecdsa-sha2-nistp256, etc.).
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) Private key in PEM format. Only available for generated keys, returned only once at creation.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# SSH keys are the one resource with a numeric id.
# The private key is never returned again, so an imported key has none.
terraform import scamp_ssh_key.main 42
```
